    • GetCurrentActiveUserQuestForEmail

      public static UserQuest GetCurrentActiveUserQuestForEmail(String email) throws IllegalArgumentException, SQLException
      Retrives the current active quest for the user matching the account
      Parameters:
      email - The email of the account you want to check
      Returns:
      The currently active UserQuest in the database or null if no active quest is set for the email
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the given email is empty
      SQLException - Database Access Failure

    • GetUserQuestsForEmail

      public static List<UserQuest> GetUserQuestsForEmail(String email) throws SQLException
      Gets every UserQuest assigned to the given account. Active quests are returned first, then not started, then complete.
      Parameters:
      email - The email of the account to load quests for
      Returns:
      A list of UserQuests, empty if the account has none
      Throws:
      SQLException - Database Access Failure
